name: numeric-table
title: Numeric table
description: A table of figures set properly: right-aligned tabular numbers, units in the header, readable negatives and a totals row.
docs: Columns declare kind (number, currency, percent or text), precision and unit; percent values are fractions. Figures are written by Intl for the locale you give, with a true minus sign and the word 'negative' for a screen reader. mark: 'highest', 'lowest' or 'both' marks a column's extremes with an arrow and words. total: 'sum', 'average' or a function fills the tfoot row; missing values read 'no data' and are left out of the sums, never counted as zero. The helpers in format.ts work on the server too.
